record.question: Under the Pharmacy Practice regulation 2015, the pharmacist must maintain a patient medication record for a minimum of:
options: Minimum of 2 years from the date of last entry
Minimum of 3 years from the date of last entry
Minimum of 5 years from the date of last entry
Minimum of 7 years from the date of last entry
record.explanation: Answer B: Minimum of 3 years from the date of last entry. The Pharmacy Practice Regulations 2015 require the pharmacist to maintain a patient medication record for a minimum of three years from the date of the last entry. Reference: https://www.pci.nic.in/pdf/Pharmacy%20Practice%20Regulations%202015.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
